device.category: semi-modular analogue polyrhythmic synthesizer, desktop or 60HP Eurorack, two VCOs with four subharmonic oscillators, two 4-step sequencers, four rhythm generators
device.based_on: Original Moog design (2020), drawing on Oskar Sala's Mixtur-Trautonium (subharmonic oscillators) and the Theremin/Cowell/Schillinger Rhythmicon (integer-ratio polyrhythms). Companion to the Mother-32 and DFAM.

sources.title: Moog Subharmonicon User Manual, Version 1 (2020)
sources.note: History, guided exploration, every control with ranges, patchbay levels and normals, transport, rhythm generators, DFAM/Mother-32 sync, Eurorack install, fine tune, MIDI CC table, ten preset patch sheets (cables legible, knob positions drawn), signal flow and specifications.

sources.title: Moog Subharmonicon firmware v1.1.0 announcement (8 March 2022), via Sonicstate, Recording Magazine, Rekkerd and MusicTech
sources.note: MIDI note transpose of running sequences; note priority by CC 91; TRIGGER ignored while EG is held; SEQ CLK outputs brought into phase with the clock.

sources.title: Rubadub, 'Subharmonicon firmware v1.1.0 now available'
sources.note: Lists MIDI pitch bend among the v1.1.0 features.

sources.title: ModWiggler, 'Moogfest Sub-Harmonicon - What Is It?' thread
sources.note: From Loopop's video: 8-ET and 8-JI are fixed to a root of C and step C, D, E...; Andrew Huang showed a standard JI diatonic scale.

architecture.synthesis_note: Subharmonic: each VCO's two subs divide its frequency by integers 1-16 (the undertone series); rhythm generators divide the tempo by integers 1-16.
architecture.polyphony_mode: paraphonic sources (two VCOs and four subs, independently tuned) through one filter and VCA
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory; fine tune, quantise and sequencer-output modes persist. Patch sheets are supplied for recall.
architecture.summary: Two VCOs (4 octaves each, C4 to C8) give square, pulse or saw; each has two subs set to f/1 to f/16 that share its waveform. Six mixer levels feed the ladder filter (20 Hz to 20 kHz, resonant to self-oscillation) and the VCA, each with its own attack/decay envelope. Sequencer 1 belongs to VCO 1, Sequencer 2 to VCO 2; each step can move the VCO pitch and/or either sub's divisor. The tempo (20 to 3,000 BPM) feeds four rhythm generators, each dividing it by 1-16 and assigned to either or both sequencers, combined by OR or XOR. Quantise and sequencer octave range are shared.

modules.name: Tempo / clock
modules.description: Master clock, 0.333 to 50 Hz (20 to 3,000 BPM at 1 PPQ). A CLOCK input overrides it; MIDI clock overrides both (then 4 PPQ). Runs only while PLAY is lit.

modules.name: Rhythm generator 1
modules.description: Divides the clock by an integer 1-16 (knob or CV) and sends the result to Sequencer 1, 2 or both. Reset to its starting phase by RESET.

modules.name: Rhythm generator 2
modules.description: Divides the clock by an integer 1-16 (knob or CV) and sends the result to Sequencer 1, 2 or both. Reset to its starting phase by RESET.

modules.name: Rhythm generator 3
modules.description: Divides the clock by an integer 1-16 (knob or CV) and sends the result to Sequencer 1, 2 or both. Reset to its starting phase by RESET.

modules.name: Rhythm generator 4
modules.description: Divides the clock by an integer 1-16 (knob or CV) and sends the result to Sequencer 1, 2 or both. Reset to its starting phase by RESET.

modules.name: Sequencer 1
modules.description: Four steps, each a bipolar offset (±1, ±2 or ±5 octaves, quantised or not) applied to VCO 1 pitch and/or its subs' divisors per SEQ 1 ASSIGN. Advances on clocks from assigned rhythm generators (OR or XOR).

modules.name: Sequencer 2
modules.description: Four steps, each a bipolar offset (±1, ±2 or ±5 octaves, quantised or not) applied to VCO 2 pitch and/or its subs' divisors per SEQ 2 ASSIGN. Advances on clocks from assigned rhythm generators (OR or XOR).

modules.name: Transport and EG triggering
modules.description: PLAY, RESET, NEXT, TRIGGER and EG mode. Combines sequencer steps (EG on), the TRIGGER button and the TRIGGER input into envelope triggers, also sent to TRIGGER OUT (1 ms, 5 V).

modules.name: VCO CV normal
modules.description: The VCO 1 input also feeds VCO 2 until a cable is in the VCO 2 input.

modules.name: MIDI input
modules.description: Type A TRS minijack MIDI: clock, notes (offset from C4 on the VCOs), CCs for VCO and sub tuning and EG times, rhythm logic.

modules.name: VCO 1
modules.description: Analogue VCO, 4 octaves (262 Hz to 4,186 Hz from the knob), optionally quantised. WAVE: square (up), pulse with PWM from SUB 1's saw (middle), saw (down); its two subs follow the switch.

modules.name: VCO 1 SUB 1
modules.description: Subharmonic oscillator: VCO 1's frequency divided by 1-16. Square, or saw in the middle and down switch positions.

modules.name: VCO 1 SUB 2
modules.description: Subharmonic oscillator: VCO 1's frequency divided by 1-16. Square, or saw in the middle and down switch positions.

modules.name: VCO 2
modules.description: Analogue VCO, 4 octaves (262 Hz to 4,186 Hz from the knob), optionally quantised. WAVE: square (up), pulse with PWM from SUB 1's saw (middle), saw (down); its two subs follow the switch.

modules.name: VCO 2 SUB 1
modules.description: Subharmonic oscillator: VCO 2's frequency divided by 1-16. Square, or saw in the middle and down switch positions.

modules.name: VCO 2 SUB 2
modules.description: Subharmonic oscillator: VCO 2's frequency divided by 1-16. Square, or saw in the middle and down switch positions.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Six levels into the filter; near maximum the mixer overdrives warmly.

modules.name: VCF (Moog ladder)
modules.description: 4-pole (-24 dB/octave) low-pass ladder filter, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, resonant to self-oscillation.

modules.name: VCF EG
modules.description: Attack 1 ms to 10 s, decay 5 ms to 10 s; holds at peak while a gate is high. Cannot restart during its attack.

modules.name: VCA EG
modules.description: Attack 1 ms to 10 s, decay 5 ms to 10 s; holds at peak while a gate is high. Cannot restart during its attack.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Output amplifier: VCA EG scaled to the VOLUME setting, summed with the VCA CV input.

modules.name: Audio output
modules.description: 1/4 inch output for an instrument cable or headphones (same signal both ears); VCA OUT patch point at Eurorack level (10 Vpp).

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: VCO 1, its two subs, VCO 2 and its two subs are mixed into the ladder filter, then the VCA (VCA EG at VOLUME), then the audio output.

behaviours.name: Subharmonics
behaviours.rule: Each sub plays its VCO's frequency divided by 1-16 (unison fully CW). Subs follow their VCO's pitch and waveform; they are not accurate above about 10 kHz.

behaviours.name: Waveform switch
behaviours.rule: UP: square on VCO and subs. MIDDLE: VCO pulse width-modulated by SUB 1's saw (an extra pitched component even with SUB 1 silent), subs saw. DOWN: saw on all. A cable in VCO PWM replaces the SUB 1 normal.

behaviours.name: Quantise
behaviours.rule: Shared: off, 12-ET, 8-ET, 12-JI, 8-JI. Steps the FREQ knobs and sequencer steps; JI chords lose the beating of ET minor chords.

behaviours.name: Sequencers
behaviours.rule: Sequencer 1 belongs to VCO 1, Sequencer 2 to VCO 2. Each step adds a bipolar offset (±1, ±2 or ±5 octaves) to the VCO pitch (subs follow) and/or to each sub's divisor, per the ASSIGN buttons. A sequencer only moves when at least one rhythm generator drives it.

behaviours.name: Rhythm generators
behaviours.rule: Each divides the tempo by 1-16 and drives Sequencer 1, 2 or both. Several on one sequencer make a polyrhythm that repeats when they meet on a downbeat. OR advances on any; XOR only when exactly one fires (CC 113).

behaviours.name: Clock sources
behaviours.rule: TEMPO 20-3,000 BPM at 1 PPQ; a CLOCK input overrides it; MIDI clock overrides both and runs at 4 PPQ. CLOCK OUT sends the current clock only while playing.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: Attack/decay, attack 1 ms-10 s, decay 5 ms-10 s. A trigger runs attack then decay; a gate holds the peak. Neither restarts during its attack. EG mode: off (steps do not trigger), on, or held open.

behaviours.name: Transport
behaviours.rule: PLAY runs sequencers, rhythms and CLOCK OUT. RESET returns everything to the start (held: holds step 1 while EGs keep firing; NEXT then steps). NEXT advances without triggering. TRIGGER restarts EGs (EG on) or gates them (EG off).

behaviours.name: Normals
behaviours.rule: The VCO 1 input also drives VCO 2 until VCO 2 is patched. SUB 1's saw modulates the VCO's pulse width until VCO PWM is patched.

behaviours.name: Pitch limits
behaviours.rule: Sequencers cannot push the VCOs above about 10 kHz; for the full ±5 octave range set FREQ fully CCW. CV inputs can still drive the VCOs higher.

behaviours.name: MIDI
behaviours.rule: Notes are offsets from C4 (FREQ fully CCW plays them as sent). 14-bit CCs move VCO pitch ±2.5 octaves and EG times; 7-bit CCs set the four sub divisors (inverted: low values = 16). Channel and transport by SysEx.

behaviours.name: Sync with other Moogs
behaviours.rule: CLOCK OUT (or TRIGGER, SEQ CLK outputs) clocks a DFAM; a Mother-32 ASSIGN output set to clock drives CLOCK IN.

behaviours.name: Eurorack
behaviours.rule: Removes from its case as a 60HP module (26 mm deep); 360 mA maximum from +12 V, no -12 V.

behaviours.name: Firmware 1.1.0
behaviours.rule: March 2022: MIDI notes transpose running sequences (for following key changes from a keyboard); note priority low/high/last by CC 91; MIDI pitch bend; TRIGGER button and input ignored while EG is held (previously they dropped the EGs to zero); SEQ 1/2 CLK outputs now in phase with the clock (previously one pulse late).

behaviours.name: Fine tune
behaviours.rule: Hold OSC 1 and OSC 2 until the QUANTIZE LEDs flash; TEMPO sets ±50 cents; QUANTIZE exits; the value is kept at power-up.

example_patches.description: Guided start: hold EG, half VCO 1 level, 12-ET, sequence VCO 1 with Rhythm 1, then release EG, PLAY, and add RHYTHM 2 SEQ 1 for a polyrhythm.

receives.note: offset from C4 on the VCOs; transposes running sequences (firmware 1.1.0)
overrides internal and analogue clock; 4 PPQ
MIDI channel and transport settings (files from moogmusic.com)

midi.cc_map_note: VCO frequency CCs add ±2.5 octaves to the knob; sub and EG CCs replace the knob until it is moved. Sub CCs are inverted in eighths (0-7 = 16 ... 120-127 = 1).
midi.channel_note: Channel 1 by default, 1-16 or all by SysEx.

specifications.sources: VCO 1, SUB 1, SUB 2 / VCO 2, SUB 1, SUB 2
specifications.filter: self-oscillating ladder, low-pass, 4-pole (-24 dB/octave), 20 Hz to 20 kHz

rear.audio: 1/4 inch TRS headphone or TS instrument

power.adapter: 100-240 V AC in, +12 V DC 1,200 mA out, centre positive

omitted_from_source: knob and button settings drawn on the ten preset patch sheets (cables are transcribed)
history and introductory theory beyond what behaviours need
not_in_source: how MIDI notes gate the envelopes (not found in research either)
whether MIDI notes reach both VCOs (implied by the manual and the transpose feature)
the exact 8-JI ratios (C major root confirmed; ratios inferred from the manual's example)
CC 91 value ranges for each priority
whether the SEQ output decoupling settings persist at power-up (a forum comment says 1.1.0 fixed settings not always being stored at power-off)
XOR behaviour with three or more rhythms on one sequencer
Research filled: 8-step scales as C major with a fixed C root, firmware 1.1.0 changes (note transpose, note priority CC 91, pitch bend, TRIGGER while held, SEQ CLK phase).
source_inconsistencies: VCA DECAY is introduced as 'The VCF DECAY knob determines...' (p.25).
VCF EG AMT inverse values are said to open the filter on 'the Release stage'; the envelope has attack and decay only (p.24).
8-ET and 8-JI are called 'Diatonic (8-step)' scales; a diatonic scale has seven notes (eight with the octave) (p.21).
Poly Rock's notes say 'Patch CLOCK OUT to VCA IN', but its drawing shows no cable (p.49).
Poly Rock's notes refer to 'SUB OSC 1, 2, 3, and 4'; the panel names them VCO 1 SUB 1/2 and VCO 2 SUB 1/2 (p.49).
Spiral Ways' notes say 'SUB VCO 1 FREQ 1' and 'SUB VCO 2 SUB 2' for VCO 1 SUB 1 and VCO 2 SUB 2 (p.48).
The XOR description covers two rhythm generators ('if both are true'); behaviour with more is not stated (p.44).

modelling_gaps.detail: OR/XOR combining of rhythm clocks into each sequencer is a global setting, recorded on the connections' note rather than as a combine property.
QUANTIZE and SEQ OCT are shared by both oscillators and sequencers; they are attached to vco1 and seq1 with that noted.
Each VCO SUB input moves both of that VCO's subs; it is attached to SUB 1's node with the dual role in the port description.
